_comment: Generated by Tools/terrain/fire_frost.mjs: the Old Island's Volcanic and Frozen tundra content (Data/island_places.json, island_dressing.json pois and caves, world.json villages, shrines, masters, hidden routes) moved onto the round island's wedges, map metres (x east, y south). old = where it was on the Old Island.

places.why: Vulkarn's crater itself (the island's centre-west peak)
places.line: Vulkarn's forge breathes smoke over the whole island.
places.name: Vulkarn's Crater

places.why: fire-frost.md's spot (moved 6 m onto even ground): the three hornitos on the Solfatara's open floor facing the crater rim
places.line: Three spatter chimneys the smiths worked as bellows. They still breathe fire in turn.
places.name: The Bellows Stacks

places.why: Pinned by the measured lava crossing: his hammer haft spans the river where the bridge row below finds both banks
places.line: A forge giant split by frost, Rime-folk spearheads still in his skull. His hammer is the only bridge over the river.
places.name: The Fallen Smith

places.why: At the foot of the obsidian cliff face (fire-frost.md's spot, 15 m onto the ledge), facing out from the glass
places.line: A cliff of black glass. Something is cut into the ledge nine metres up.
places.name: Glasswall

places.why: The sulfur vents on the Solfatara's fumarole ground (fire-frost.md's spot, 24 m onto it)
places.line: Sulfur vents the miners worked. At night their fire burns blue.
places.name: The Blue Fire

places.line: The smiths' beacon on the west headland. It burns again once the Kipuka's shrine is kindled.
places.name: The Slag Light
places.why: The smiths' beacon for ships on the west coast: the west headland's tip (the most open sea round it, on the cliff top at the water's edge), lit by the Kipuka's shrine. fire-frost.md's sea stack at -1880, +120 is open water on the built island
Pinned by the Kipuka shrine's clearing in the lava field
places.line: Old forest the lava flowed around: the only living green in the Volcanic.
places.name: Ash Pine Kipuka

places.why: Pinned by Ignessa's arena (the spire behind her ring)
places.line: A twisted spire behind Ignessa's ring, crowned with her wisps.
places.name: Wisp Spire

places.why: Set from Rimehold village toward the glacier: the village's gate
places.line: The Rime-folk's gate of mammoth tusks, facing the glacier.
places.name: The Tusk Gate

places.why: fire-frost.md's spot on the rise over the Inuksuk Road, its arm pointing at the glacier
places.line: Nine metres of stacked stone. Its arm points at the glacier.
places.name: The Great Inuksuk

places.why: In the ice shelf's old shoreline (fire-frost.md's spot, 39 m onto the shelf), prow toward the old sea
places.line: A Rime-folk longboat locked in the ice from when the shelf was sea.
places.name: The Frozen Whaler

places.why: On the shelf's edge below the glacier bowl (fire-frost.md's spot), facing the bowl
places.line: A wall of blue ice towers. Listen for the crack before one falls.
places.name: The Weeping Seracs

places.line: An ice-cored mound where the aurora foxes gather.
places.name: The Fox Circle Pingo
places.why: Pingos rise from flat permafrost lowland (drained lake beds): the flattest open snow of the Snow Flats near the design spot, away from the sea and the lake ice, under open sky for the aurora
Pinned by the Pale Hunter's arena
places.line: Dead white pines round the Pale Hunter's ground. No light reaches here.
places.name: The Pale Pines

places.why: Pinned by Grimjaw's arena over the river ice
places.line: A natural ice bridge over the river ice. Something lives beneath it.
places.name: The Ice Arch

places.why: On Cinderhorn's loop (creatures.json roam): the bull ploughs his own trench, the basalt pillars along it
places.name: The Plough Trench
The Miners' Grave
places.why: The miners died fleeing an eruption toward the shore: on the line from the Blue Fire's pits to the nearest shore, 60-140 m out, the bodies facing the sea they never reached

places.name: The Miners' Camp
places.why: "The miners' camp below" the Blue Fire: the nearest flat lower ground 70-170 m from the pits (6 m+ below them, out of the fumes), the tents facing the work

places.name: The Charred Caravan
places.why: Smith wagons burn where they stood: on the Slag-Cairn road where it passes nearest the design spot, the guards' blades pointing toward the north pass the attack came from
In the old lava field beside the Kipuka (fire-frost.md's spot): the lava came through a living forest
places.name: The Tree-Mold Field

places.why: At the crater wall's foot (fire-frost.md's spot), climbing toward the rim
places.name: The Crater Stair

places.why: Pinned by the Obsidian Warden's arena: the quarry face beside it
places.name: The Warden's Quarry
The Shard Field
places.why: Obsidian blades are shed by the ridges: the gentle apron at the foot of the steepest obsidian face near the design spot, spread downhill from it

places.name: The Ridge Watch
places.why: The smiths' watchtower: the volcanic-side crest with an unbroken sight line from its roof to the north pass (250-800 m off), seeing the crater too (it reveals the Crater Highlands); its slits face the pass
A mound of chewed ore on the Obsidian Ridges' lower ground (fire-frost.md's spot, 50 m onto even ground)
places.name: The Kilnmite Hill
The Acid Pool
places.why: Acid run-off from the fumarole fields pools where it can't drain: the deepest closed hollow among the Solfatara's fumarole fields (ground 0.8 m+ higher all round at 30 m: a shallow pan, as the real ones are; fire-frost.md's -230, -980 is on the ridge face), the cart rolled down its side
On the Solfatara's fumarole ground (fire-frost.md's spot)
places.name: The Steam Ground

places.why: On Old Tusker's loop (creatures.json roam): he wallows on his own round
places.name: Old Tusker's Wallow
The Tusk Midden
places.why: Tusks stacked by the dozen half-frozen in a bank: flat footing against a slope that rises behind it, the stacked face looking out from the bank

places.name: The Sledge Wreck Line
places.why: Three sledges abandoned in a line toward the coast: flat snow 60-160 m inland near the design spot, the line pointing at the nearest shore

places.name: The Ice-Fishing Camp
places.why: Ice-fishers walk a short way out: lake ice 15-45 m from the shore nearest the design spot, the windbreak's back to the open ice and the camp facing the shore

places.name: The Drowned Sledge
places.why: A sledge and dogs frozen under clear ice where they went through: lake ice 20-120 m out near the design spot; it points at the nearest thin ice (set below, once the thin ice is placed)
Pinned by the Pale Hunter's arena: the tent at the edge of his dead pines
places.name: The Pale Hunter's Camp

places.why: Over a game trail in the Pine Hollows (fire-frost.md's spot)
places.name: The Hunter's Blind
The Fallen Giant Pine
places.why: The only bridge over a ravine: a 34 m pine lying bank to bank where both banks stand 3.5 m+ over the gully between them, its root plate on the higher bank

places.name: The Glacimaw Boneyard
places.why: Where the Glacimaw surfaces through the snow: the flattest level 20 m disc of the ice shelf near the design spot, the bone ring round churned snow
Down the cliff where Skaldrith lands (fire-frost.md's spot), facing the bowl
places.name: The Wyrm Claw Scars
The Watch Cairn
places.why: The Rime-folk's mirror of the Ridge Watch: the tundra-side crest with an unbroken sight line from the cairn's wall to the north pass, seeing the glacier bowl too (it reveals the Glacier Plateau); spear rack facing the pass

places.name: The Moulin of Voices
places.why: Meltwater finds the lowest point of the ice shelf and drills down: a gentle low 1.5 m+ below the ground round it near the design spot, the channels running in
Below the Crevasse Shrine on the shelf (fire-frost.md's spot)
places.name: The Crevasse Maze

places.why: At the south pass where the Fire's heat leaks through (fire-frost.md's spot)
places.name: The Steam Ground
